coordinates.origin: Skull centred horizontally, lower jaw lowest point on Z0; meters preserved

concept.reason: Official original fossil lateral/dorsal photographs and explanatory dorsal drawing establish the target. Extra generated concept adds no factual geometry.

scope: Original three-dimensional lobe-finned fish skull with large spiracular openings. No full fish, fin or shoulder reconstruction; no flattened slab proxy.
reference_specimen: NMV P221807, Long et al2006 Fig1a–e
material_policy: Opaque restrained ivory/bone palette, slightly differentiated structural panels, dark cavity through shading not filled black disks. Figure specimen whitened with ammonium chloride; palette conveys study model not original living colour.

scale.status: Approximate figure-derived reference envelope, not a published direct measurement. Fig1a from rear to snout spans about5.4 times its 1cm scale bar, rounded55mm.
scale.measurement_basis: Official Fig1 rendered600px wide: scale bar about99px, lateral skull envelope about540px.
scale.uncertainty: Envelope width/depth are inferred from available oblique/lateral and partial dorsal references; not scan precision.

diagnostic_targets: Short rounded broad snout, domed cranial roof and broad cheeks with a slightly ajar continuous lower jaw, following panel a.
Separate bilateral orbital openings in anterolateral roof and large posterodorsolateral spiracular notches behind them. Spiracles cannot be confused with eye holes.
Down-folded bony margins bound the open spiracular region; make visible depth and real openings.
Lower jaw is substantial and tapering forward; narrow mouth gap exposes a fine tooth fringe rather than giant mammalian tusks.
Low relief restrained dermal panel boundaries; no added horns, antlers, scales, fish skin or eyeballs.
Keep a genuinely three-dimensional skull, readable in default front/side/top/perspective.
anatomy_note: Study focuses on external skull and documented spiracular apertures. Exact internal CT chamber mesh and unseen palate are not reproduced; no false claims of a scan-exact specimen.
uncertainties: Bilateral reconstruction of incomplete dorsal material is explicit symmetry inference.
Exact sutural paths simplified; preservation breaks are not all anatomical sutures.
Approximate55mm envelope is figure-scaled, not independently measured museum specimen.
Do not use comparison taxa Fig1f/h as Gogonasus. Panelg alone is its isolated palatoquadrate.
acceptance_checklist: Original fossil skull scope, no full animal or slab.
Orbital and spiracular openings separate and obvious from top and side.
Fine jaw dentition and continuous substantial mandible, not arbitrary loose bones.
Spiracular rim turns downward and opening has visible cavity depth.
Source self-contained; two rebuilds and exact-GLB four views; no placeholder images.
Metadata preserves approximate size and reconstructed/simplified areas.
